title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 31 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: allies & theaters and maritime & undersea autonomy.

stories.h: ‘The West can’t stop me’: Space wars heat up as Russia tails a Ukraine-linked US satellite
stories.what: Washington blamed Moscow for deliberately moving a Russian military satellite with an undisclosed mission close last week to a U.S.-registered satellite.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: Japan weighs rewrite of its military AI policy
stories.what: Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said on Oct. 19 that the basic policy governing how the Ministry of Defense and the Self-Defense Forces use artificial intelligence needs to be reviewed, telling lawmakers that AI development has moved faster than…
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: Denmark To Buy Anthem Munitions, Joint Strike Missiles In Dual Long-Range Strike Push
stories.what: The ground- and air-launched weapons will give Denmark all-new options for striking deep behind enemy lines as NATO reinforces its Baltic flank.
stories.you: Weapons stockpiles are short, so anyone who can make missiles and rocket motors faster and cheaper has buyers.

stories.h: Russia and China step up spy flights near Japan
stories.what: China and Russia sent military intelligence aircraft toward Japan on four consecutive days this week, prompting the Japan Air Self-Defense Force to scramble fighters each day, as two Chinese Y-9 aircraft crossed the gap between Okinawa and Miyako-jima into…
stories.you: Allies' wars and budgets are the testing ground and a big second market for new defense tech.

stories.h: China’s Liaoning carrier: 10 years from training ship to warship
stories.what: China’s Liaoning carrier group has carried out its second far-seas training deployment to the Western Pacific this year, a decade after the carrier’s first such voyage in 2016, Chinese state broadcaster CCTV reported on Oct.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

watch.why: Around November 3. Whether US commercial growth keeps outpacing government revenue.

idea.h: GPS-denied navigation module ('Intel Inside' for drones)
idea.why: A small vision, inertial and terminal-guidance board any airframe maker can integrate; later, quantum-ready. Jamming is everywhere; most vendors can't build autonomy in-house. As airframes become commodities, the margin sits in components like this.
